nodes.label: shadcn/ui Theming & Customization
nodes.rationale: Reference doc covering dark mode setup, CSS variable system, Tailwind configuration, color customization, component customization, and best practices.

nodes.label: Dark Mode Setup
nodes.rationale: Dark mode via next-themes ThemeProvider with attribute=class, defaultTheme=system, enableSystem, plus theme toggle button.

nodes.label: CSS Variable System
nodes.rationale: Theming via HSL CSS variables in globals.css (:root and .dark overrides), hsl(var(--x)) usage, 50% opacity via hsl(var(--x) / 0.5).

nodes.label: Tailwind Configuration
nodes.rationale: Map CSS variables to Tailwind colors (border/input/ring/background/foreground/primary/secondary/destructive/muted/accent) and borderRadius from --radius, darkMode class.

nodes.label: Color Customization
nodes.rationale: Customize colors by updating CSS variables, theme generator at ui.shadcn.com/themes, or multiple themes via data-theme attributes.

nodes.label: Component Customization
nodes.rationale: Components live in codebase and are modified directly: customize cva variants/sizes, modify base styles, override with className prop.

nodes.label: Base Color Presets
nodes.rationale: shadcn/ui init base colors: Slate, Gray, Zinc, Neutral, Stone; select during setup or change later via CSS variables.

nodes.label: Style Variants
nodes.rationale: Two styles: Default (softer, rounded) and New York (sharp, more contrast), selected in components.json style field.
